rationale: v1.80.1 has only per-space/card signal controls. This adds an installation-wide GUI preference and an explicit inherit/on/off choice for each space; it is a new user feature, not repair of an intermediate beta.

summary.ru: Показ Zigbee-сигнала можно настроить сразу для всего дома, сохранив отдельные настройки этажей.
summary.en: Set Zigbee signal visibility for the whole home while keeping individual floor overrides.
